changeSet.author: arena
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_fee_charge ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, academy_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.customer(id), student_id BIGINT NOT NULL, batch_id BIGINT, description VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK(amount > 0), due_date DATE NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_by VARCHAR(100), FOREIGN KEY(student_id,academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_student(id,academy_id), FOREIGN KEY(batch_id,academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.training_batch(id,academy_id), UNIQUE(id,academy_id) ); CREATE INDEX academy_fee_scope_due ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_fee_charge(academy_id,due_date,student_id,batch_id); CREATE TABLE ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_payment ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, academy_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.customer(id), student_id BIGINT NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK(amount > 0), payment_date DATE NOT NULL, method VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK(method IN ('CASH','BANK_TRANSFER','UPI','CARD','OTHER')), reference VARCHAR(120), notes VARCHAR(500), recorded_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, recorded_by VARCHAR(100), FOREIGN KEY(student_id,academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_student(id,academy_id), UNIQUE(id,academy_id) ); CREATE INDEX academy_payment_scope_date ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_payment(academy_id,payment_date,student_id); CREATE TABLE ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_payment_allocation ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, academy_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.customer(id), payment_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_payment(id), charge_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_fee_charge(id), amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK(amount > 0), created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY(payment_id,academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_payment(id,academy_id), FOREIGN KEY(charge_id,academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_fee_charge(id,academy_id) ); CREATE INDEX academy_payment_allocation_charge ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_payment_allocation(academy_id,charge_id);
